_: Days a forward-only stream did not collect.
`gaps` are holes that remain. `partial` are days recovered from a THINNER
source than the live capture -- they are not holes any more, but they are
not comparable to a normally-collected day either, and a reader who does
not know that will read a thin day as a quiet one. Both entries exist so
that absent is not quiet AND recovered is not equivalent.
ACKNOWLEDGING IS NOT FIXING. Only the exact date+stream pairs under `gaps`
are silenced in /health; any new gap still fires, and agent.py's selftest
asserts the ledger cannot silence a whole date or a whole stream.
Add an entry only after confirming the day is genuinely unrecoverable --

gaps.why: the machine was asleep for the whole session. NSE's reportASM/reportGSM are current-state endpoints with no date parameter and no historical archive; the news feeds (ET, Livemint, Bing) serve recent items only. Neither can be asked for a past day. The bhavcopy was refetched by --catchup, the NSE weekly filings self-healed, and the BSE filings were recovered later -- see `partial`.
Saturday; no wake is scheduled outside weekday evenings, so the capture did not run. The news feeds cannot be asked for a past day. BSE filings for this date were recovered -- see `partial`.

partial.why: backfilled with bse_announcements.fetch_past_day, which reads the dated AnnSubCategoryGetData endpoint. That endpoint's mandatory strSearch=P filters it: refetching days we already hold gives 2,153 rows against the live feed's 10,760 on a weekday, so roughly a fifth. This day is THIN by collection method, not by how much was filed.
